comment removed.
No CDN requests or npm install are required by Obleth Chat at build/runtime.

Update by downloading a reviewed tagged npm release with npm pack
--ignore-scripts, verifying the registry integrity, and replacing the bundle
and the license notices. Run tests/markdown.test.mjs after updates.
